title: Symmetry of the second real differential
statement:
Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $E,F$ be finite-dimensional normed real vector spaces (each spanned by finitely many vectors), let $U\subseteq E$ be open, and let $f:U\to F$ be twice continuously differentiable in real coordinates. For every $x\in U$ and $v,w\in E$, the second real Frechet differential is symmetric:
$$D^2f(x)[v,w]=D^2f(x)[w,v].$$
